title: NoScreenShare
description: Prevent your huds from being visible in a screenshare
body:
# NoScreenShare

**NoScreenshare** is a Fabric mod that opens a clean, HUD-free second window you can share on Discord, OBS, or any screenshare tool; while your main window shows everything as normal.

---

## How it works

When you launch Minecraft with NoScreenshare installed, a second window titled **"NoScreenshare - Shareable View"** opens automatically. This window mirrors your game but shows only the vanilla HUD with no mod overlays, no client watermarks, or any screen generated by other mods.

Share that window. Keep your main window to yourself.

---

## ⚙️ Features

- **Automatic secondary window:** opens on launch, closes when you exit. 
- **Vanilla only view** — mod HUDs and overlays are stripped from the shareable window. The main window is untouched.
- **No stutter** — vsync is disabled on the secondary window and GPU sync is handled via fence objects to avoid compounding vblank waits (breaks when you use meteor client).
- **Resizable:**  drag the secondary window to any size (fixed for hyprland).

**DOES NOT WORK WITH ESP OR BLOCK RENDERERS, THEREFORE METEOR AND MOST HACKED CLIENT ESP WILL NOT WORK OR CAUSE STUTTER**

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
2. Drop the `.jar` into your `mods/` folder
3. Launch the game. The shareable window opens automatically

---

## 🛠️ Requirements

| Dependency     | Version         |
|----------------|-----------------|
| Minecraft       | 26.1.2          |
| Fabric Loader   | ≥ 0.19.2        |
| Fabric API      | any             |
| Java            | ≥ 25            |
